The '''TR-62 Autocushion Tripod''' was a model of weapon [[Tripod (weapon attachment)/Legends|tripod]] manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. It was designed for use with the [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]], with the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapon being mounted onto the tripod at the midpoint, and the power conduit from the [[Class-4T3 power generator/Legends|Class-4T3]] being attached to a connector on the underside.<ref name="EGWT" />
